definition: נֹחַ 46 proper name, masculine Noah (Nabataean proper name נוח Lzb 322 , Syriac proper name Meissn VOJ viii, (1894), 303 near the end (No. 116)); — Gen 5:29 (where traditional etymology), + 40 t. Gen 5-10 (not in E D ); 1Chr 1:4 נֹחַ דָּנִאֵל וְאִיּוֺב Ezek 14:14 ; Ezek 14:20 מֵי נֹחַ = flood Isa 54:9 (twice in verse); ᵐ5 Νωε . — On history of interpretion of name see Goldziher ZMG xxiv. (1870), 207 ff .
